items.title: Phu Wiang National Park
items.subtitle: 4.5 ( 358 ) ‧ National park in Thailand ‧ Open
items.description: Phu Wiang National Park is in Khon Kaen Province, northeastern Thailand, covering the area of the Phu Wiang Mountains. It is best known for its numerous dinosaur bone paleontological sites, The park is one of the world's largest dinosaur graveyards.
